question.text: How many federal units will Fiocruz's InfoGripe SE 44 bulletin (released 12 November 2026) flag with SRAG incidence at alert level or above and a rising long-term trend?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves using the "Resumo do Boletim InfoGripe – Semana Epidemiológica (SE) 44 2026" published by Fiocruz, expected at https://agencia.fiocruz.br/sites/agencia.fiocruz.br/files/Resumo_InfoGripe_2026_44.pdf ; a version of that file with a filename suffix (e.g. Resumo_InfoGripe_2026_44_0.pdf) counts as the same document. The resolved value is the number of Brazilian federal units (26 states plus the Federal District, out of 27 total) that this edition reports as having SRAG incidence at alert level, risk level, or high risk (based on the last two weeks) together with a rising long-term trend (last six weeks) — the figure given in the edition's national-situation bullet of the form "N das 27 unidades federativas apresentam incidência de SRAG em nível de alerta ou risco (últimas duas semanas) com sinal de crescimento na tendência de longo prazo (últimas 6 semanas) até a semana 44", followed by the names of those units. If the edition lists the qualifying units without stating a total, count the distinct units listed; if a stated total and the number of units named disagree, the stated total prevails. If the SE 44 summary is not hosted at that URL or a suffixed variant, the same document published elsewhere on agencia.fiocruz.br or fiocruz.br, or Fiocruz's own press release reporting the SE 44 figure, may be used; failing that, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) may be used. If publication of the SE 44 edition is delayed beyond 13 November 2026, the question resolves on that edition once it is published.
question.fine_print: A "federal unit" (unidade federativa, UF) means one of Brazil's 26 states or the Federal District. A UF counts as "at alert level or above" if the bulletin classifies its SRAG incidence over the last two weeks as "nível de alerta", "nível de risco", or "alto risco" (any level above the low/green baseline). If Fiocruz publishes a corrected version of the SE 44 summary before 23:59 UTC on 13 November 2026, the corrected version is used.

research:
I couldn't find the deciding figure, because the SE 44 summary doesn't exist yet. As of today (2 November 2026) the latest published edition is SE 42, which flagged **5 UFs**. The SE 43 edition comes out on 5 November.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: The SE 44 file (`Resumo_InfoGripe_2026_44.pdf`) returns HTTP 404, which is expected since it is due 12 November. [Fiocruz](https://agencia.fiocruz.br/sites/agencia.fiocruz.br/files/Resumo_InfoGripe_2026_44.pdf)
- 2026-11-02: The SE 43 file (`Resumo_InfoGripe_2026_43.pdf`) also returns 404. It is due Thursday 5 November. [Fiocruz](https://agencia.fiocruz.br/sites/agencia.fiocruz.br/files/Resumo_InfoGripe_2026_43.pdf)
- The SE 42 summary PDF is online, but I couldn't extract its text because the PDF streams are compressed. Its figure is confirmed below from Agência Brasil.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The SE 44 edition covers data through 7 November.
- 2026-10-29 (SE 42): 5 of 27 UFs were at alert or risk with long-term growth: Amapá, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe and Maranhão. Roraima and Santa Catarina were at alert, risk or high risk without growth. Nationally the trend was stabilising, with a slight rise in severe COVID-19 cases (MT, MS, SP, RJ). [Agência Brasil / Rádio Nacional](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/radioagencia-nacional/saude/audio/2026-10/sindrome-respiratoria-aguda-esta-em-nivel-de-alerta-em-cinco-estados)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

Its page metadata says "590 days ago", so it is almost certainly a March 2025 story and **should not be read as 2026 data**. [Capital News](https://www.capitalnews.com.br/nacional/infogripe-12-das-27-unidades-federativas-apresentam-incidencia-de-srag-em-nivel-de-alerta/418791)

  - Positivity: influenza A about 4%, influenza B 5.4%, RSV 11.5%, SARS-CoV-2 6.4%.
  - Almost 170,000 SRAG cases so far in 2026.
  - [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/radioagencia-nacional/saude/audio/2026-10/sindrome-respiratoria-aguda-esta-em-nivel-de-alerta-em-cinco-estados)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **2026-11-05 (Thu):** SE 43 bulletin and summary (data through 31 October). This is the key input: it shows whether the SE 42 count of 5, and the rise in the three-week trend, carried on.

- Things that could move the count:
  - Metapneumovirus rising in SP, RJ, ES, MS, PR, AL, BA, PE and SE.
  - A slight COVID-19 uptick in MT, MS, SP and RJ.
  - Rising SRAG among children in Aracaju and Cuiabá.
  - Data backfill: late notifications can revise recent weeks' trend signals.

- **How a state gets flagged:** it needs incidence at alert level or above together with a growth signal over the six-week trend. A state drops out as its trend stabilises, even while it stays in the alert zone, as Roraima and Santa Catarina did at SE 42. [Search summary of InfoGripe methodology]
